A proprietary blend is any supplement that doesn't list the precise amount of every single active ingredient it contains. This isn’t just prevalent with pre-workouts and fat-burners – a lot of protein powders on the market are proprietary blends because they don’t tell you the exact amounts of the proteins in the formula. description: Casein is the most abundant protein in cow’s milk, accounting for almost 80%. It consists of a very rich pool of amino acids, nearly identical to whey protein which is a byproduct of cheese. The amino acids within casein is high in essential aminos, responsible for muscle protein synthesis, or MPS. Casein is comparatively insoluble, forming clots within the stomach during digestion. Additionally, it tends to form structures called micelles that continue to increase solubility in water. This slows down the rate of gastric emptying, affecting the rate at which the amino acids are absorbed into the blood stream. In simple terms, casein takes longer to digest in the stomach and slows down the amount of amino acids being released into the small intestine where it is absorbed. This causes a steady flow of amino acids into the blood stream for hours, which is why bodybuilders use casein for muscle recover after workouts. And so, it is often taken during bedtime for the muscle repair and recovery. Micellar casein is the type of casein that are not likely to denature, taking longer to breakdown in the intestinal tracts.

what it is: the perfect blend of three of the most effective types of proteins for building muscle: whey, micellar casein, and Egg protein. what sets It apart: aside from being a protein blend in a crowded market of sometimes under per forming 100% whey protein powders, Pro Jim is also a non-proprietary blend. A proprietary blend is any supplement that doesn't list the precise amount of every single active ingredient it contains. This isn't just prevalent with pre-workouts and fat-burners – a lot of protein powders on the market are proprietary blends because they don't tell you the exact amounts of the proteins in the formula. description:
What Is Casein Protein Powder?

Casein protein powder is a protein derived from milk. Milk contains two types of protein: casein and whey. Whey protein is fast digesting, which means it is absorbed extremely quickly and is great for taking immediately after exercise. description:
What Is Casein Protein Powder?

Casein protein powder is a protein derived from milk. Milk contains two types of protein: casein and whey. Whey protein is fast digesting, which means it is absorbed extremely quickly and is great for taking immediately after exercise. Casein protein is slow-digesting, which means it releases amino acids slowly instead of quickly like whey. Casein protein is often taken before periods of rest and sleep.

Casein Protein Powder Benefits

Casein protein powder contains BCAAs and may assist in the recovery of muscles after strenuous physical activity.* Supplementation of casein protein may also help with general development of lean muscle mass at a faster rate.* In addition to its high protein content, one serving of casein contains almost half of the daily recommended value of calcium, which may promote healthy bones.*

description:
Body Fortress Super Advanced Whey Protein is the ideal post workout protein supplement featuring 100 percent Premium Whey enhanced with Creatine and other critical Amino Acids. For adults, add one (1) scoop to 6 to 8 ounces or two (2) scoops to 14 to 16 ounces of your favorite beverage. Consume within 10 minutes after mixing. Take this product with an adequate daily fluid intake. Super Advanced Whey Protein can be taken immediately following exercise or as needed throughout the day in order to meet your daily protein requirements. Use in conjunction with an intense daily exercise program and a balanced diet including an adequate caloric intake. Stir: 20 30 seconds or until completely blended. Shake: cover and shake for 25 30 seconds. Blend: cover and blend for 20 30 seconds. Not intended for use by pregnant or nursing women. If you are taking any medications or have any medical condition, consult your doctor before use. Avoid this product if you have kidney disease. Discontinue use and consult your doctor if adverse reactions occur. Not intended for use by persons under the age of 18. Keep out of reach of children. Store at room temperature, tightly closed and avoid excessive heat. For your protection, do not use if seal cap is broken or missing.

description:
What Is Casein Protein Powder?

Casein protein powder is a protein derived from milk. Milk contains two types of protein: casein and whey. Whey protein is fast digesting, which means it is absorbed extremely quickly and is great for taking immediately after exercise. Casein protein is slow-digesting, which means it releases amino acids slowly instead of quickly like whey. Casein protein is often taken before periods of rest and sleep.

Casein Protein Powder Benefits

Casein protein powder contains BCAAs and may assist in the recovery of muscles after strenuous physical activity.* Supplementation of casein protein may also help with general development of lean muscle mass at a faster rate.* In addition to its high protein content, one serving of casein contains almost half of the daily recommended value of calcium, which may promote healthy bones.*

احصل على قوة أكبر من بروتين مصل اللبن العادي.
يحتوي نيترو تيك على جرعة 3 غرام مثبتة من الأبحاث من مونوهيدرات الكرياتين، والتي تساعد - جنبًا إلى جنب مع بروتين مصل الحليب - على بناء قوة أكبر من بروتين مصل الحليب العادي. في دراسة متطورة، زاد عدد الأشخاص الذين يستخدمون تركيبة المكونات الأساسية في نيترو تك قوة الضغط القصوى على المقعد بمقدار 1 مرة بمقدار 35 باوند، مقارنة بـ 15 باوند فقط. للأشخاص الذين يستخدمون بروتين مصل الحليب العادي. بروتين مصل الحليب العادي جيد، ولكن المكونات الأساسية في نيترو تيك تظهر أنها تفوق بروتين مصل الحليب العادي. في نفس الدراسة لمدة 6 أسابيع، اكتسب الأشخاص الذين يستخدمون المكونات الأساسية في نيترو تيك عضلاتهم أكثر هزيلة من المواد التي تستخدم بروتين مصل الحليب العادي (18 مقابل 5 رطل). والحصول على قوة مضاعفة على الضغط على المقعد مقارنة بالأهداف التي تستخدم بروتين مصل الحليب العادي (34 مقابل 15 رطل). شاهد الدراسة الكاملة هنا.

What Is Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate?

Whey is a substance produced during cheese production. It is the liquid content that remains after the milk has curdled and coagulated. Whey can be processed and isolated into three different types of protein: whey protein isolate, whey protein concentrate, and whey protein hydrolysate. This particular form of whey isolate is hydrolyzed, meaning that proteins are broken into small segments to promote rapid and easy digestion. Because of this, amino acid delivery into the bloodstream can be much faster than in typical whey protein.

The seed grows best in warm climates that have acidic soil and a good drainage system. It has been described as a super food due to its nutritional value and potential benefits to the body. The Sacha Inchi seed contains a high level of protein, and is very rich in omega-3 which the human body cannot produce naturally. Sacha Inchi can be digested easily and is unlikely to cause any allergy and irritation. PLANT DESCRIPTION When planted, Sacha Inchi produces small white flowers which appear in a cluster in its fifth month and bears seed at eight months. The plant produces seed all through the year. The fruits are green when growing, but become black or dark brown when they are ripe. When the plant is some years gone, there may be hundred of fruits to harvest, a hundred fruit produces about 400 to 500 seeds. The seeds are oval-shaped, and measure about 2cm in diameter. Sacha Inchi seeds are usually roasted and eaten as a quality snack. IS SACHA INCHI A NUT? Sachi Inchi is a drupe, which is a fruit surrounding a shell with seeds in it. These seeds form part of what you eat. Sachi Inchi may look like a nut, but it is not and totally unrelated to the legume and nut family. HEALTH BENEFITS OF SACHI INCHI BUILDS IMMUNE SYSTEM Sacha Inchi seeds contain a high level of the tryptophan hormone that helps the brain to release stress and reduce inflammation, which could lead to serious illness; it also reduces depression, fatigue, and memory loss. description:
What Is Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate?

Whey is a substance produced during cheese production. It is the liquid content that remains after the milk has curdled and coagulated. Whey can be processed and isolated into three different types of protein: whey protein isolate, whey protein concentrate, and whey protein hydrolysate. This particular form of whey isolate is hydrolyzed, meaning that proteins are broken into small segments to promote rapid and easy digestion. Because of this, amino acid delivery into the bloodstream can be much faster than in typical whey protein.

Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate Benefits

Hydrolyzed whey protein isolate powder is a rich source of protein that may support muscle growth and aid in the recovery of exhausted muscles after anaerobic exercise.* This protein powder is also a rich source of leucine and branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs), essential amino acids that are largely found in muscle tissues and used primarily in the production of proteins.

WHAT IS LEAN WHEY REVOLUTION?

Lean Whey Revolution is a whey protein powder engineered to enhance lean muscle gain and promote muscle recovery. HOW DOES LEAN WHEY WORK?

Whey protein is widely regarded as the most anabolic protein source around due to its high leucine content. description:
POWERED BY ULTRA FAST ABSORBING WHEY PEPTIDES AND WHEY PROTEIN ISOLATE
Whey protein is the king of proteins! Bodybuilders and other athletes have relied on this easily absorbed, high biological value protein to help them build muscle as part of their training programs for more than 20 years. High quality whey protein contains high amounts of the amino acid leucine, one of the key building blocks of muscle and a key trigger of protein synthesis in the body, and is also high in other BCAAs – making it perfect for post workout recovery and overall musclebuilding. Each scoop of Premium Gold 100 percent Whey Protein is packed with 24g of whey, including high quality whey peptides, whey protein concentrate and whey protein isolate.

WHEY PEPTIDES
Also known as hydrolyzed whey protein, whey peptides are fast absorbing whey protein micro fractions. They have the powerful ability to promote rapid recovery from exercise and improve nutrient delivery. What’s more, whey peptides have one of the highest biological values (BV) of any protein source, a value given to protein sources to measure how well they are absorbed and used by the body.

Clinical research on whey peptides shows that they can promote rapid recovery from exercise! This is a direct response to whey peptides rapidly releasing an abundance of amino acids in the blood. With Premium Gold 100 percent Whey Protein, you’re getting an ultra pure, rapidly absorbed and quickly digested protein that allows you to recover faster, build more lean muscle mass and get better results from your training sessions!

WHEY ISOLATE
Our whey protein isolate is micro filtered to remove lactose, carbs and fat. This premium whey protein isolate provides your body with the highest biological value (BV) protein fractions. BV is a measure of how much of the protein’s compounds your body holds on to – a higher BV indicates a protein source with more musclebuilding potential.

FULLY DISCLOSED FORMULA
Each bottle of Premium Gold 100 percent Whey Protein is fully disclosed with no proprietary blends or hidden or underdosed ingredients. In addition, Team MuscleTech guarantees you are getting the exact amount of real protein that is displayed the labels – each and every scoop contains the full amount of protein stated on the label and is 100 percent real protein!

BEST IN CLASS TASTE
MuscleTech researchers worked closely with industry leading flavoring experts to constantly ensure that each high quality serving of Premium Gold 100 percent Whey Protein delivers all the mouthwatering, decadent taste of your favorite milkshake, while still delivering quality nutrition without the extra fat and carbs that many other protein powders have.

Continuous levels of hyperinsulinemia can, over time, cause alterations in the effective use of carbohydrates, and in their metabolism by muscle cells, with a "down regulation" of expression of the fat oxidation gene. The more powerful the insulin response is, the more resistant muscle cells in particular will become to its effects, causing an excess of the unused circulating glucose being converted into triglycerides via "de novo lipogenesis".


These triglycerides then go to construct storage material in adipose tissue and feed an altered metabolic situation that runs contrary to the objectives of any athlete, in terms of muscle building, weight loss, and health in general. "GDAs'' are dietary supplements that help the body absorb carbohydrates more efficiently and direct them towards the formation of muscle and liver glycogen. They support the work and intensity of insulin itself, improving muscle cell sensitivity, and encouraging the ingested carbohydrates to convert into new muscle glycogen, thereby optimising training performance and promoting muscle recovery.

description: Hydrolysis is the natural intestinal process of breaking down whole proteins found in food and supplements into smaller proteins, called peptides (Micro Peptides), and amino acids. In order to be absorbed, protein must be hydrolyzed down to amino acids or to the smallest peptides, called di and tripeptides. Whole proteins, including whey isolates, concentrates, caseins, soy, and blends are large proteins and naturally contain little to no Micro Peptides, and no di and tripeptides. Proto Whey is 100% Micro Peptides, of which, up to 40% are di and tripeptides. Targeted Protein DeliveryThe di and tripeptides in Proto Whey target the PEPT-1 transporter which transports over 8,400 different di and tripeptides. Whole protein digestion relies heavily on amino acid transporters which are far more specific and transport only a fraction of what PEPT-1 transporters do. The speed and efficiency of the PEPT-1 transport system allows for faster delivery of protein throughout the body and bypasses other systems that can limit the delivery of amino acids. Di and tripeptides carry metabolic information not present in amino acids. High-DH proteins deliver protein into the blood primarily as di and tripeptides whereas whole protein digestion often results in single amino acids. EAAs cannot be synthesized by the body and must be supplied by the diet. + Employs DEM (digestive energy matrix), a unique combination of SoftPsil micronized psyllium finer and MCTs (medium chain triglycerides) to provide digestive energy and help maintain optimum intestinal health. + High-DH reduces ...

The seed grows best in warm climates that have acidic soil and a good drainage system. It has been described as a super food due to its nutritional value and potential benefits to the body. The Sacha Inchi seed contains a high level of protein, and is very rich in omega-3 which the human body cannot produce naturally. Sacha Inchi can be digested easily and is unlikely to cause any allergy and irritation. PLANT DESCRIPTION When planted, Sacha Inchi produces small white flowers which appear in a cluster in its fifth month and bears seed at eight months. The plant produces seed all through the year. The fruits are green when growing, but become black or dark brown when they are ripe. When the plant is some years gone, there may be hundred of fruits to harvest, a hundred fruit produces about 400 to 500 seeds. The seeds are oval-shaped, and measure about 2cm in diameter. Sacha Inchi seeds are usually roasted and eaten as a quality snack. IS SACHA INCHI A NUT? Sachi Inchi is a drupe, which is a fruit surrounding a shell with seeds in it. These seeds form part of what you eat. Sachi Inchi may look like a nut, but it is not and totally unrelated to the legume and nut family. HEALTH BENEFITS OF SACHI INCHI BUILDS IMMUNE SYSTEM Sacha Inchi seeds contain a high level of the tryptophan hormone that helps the brain to release stress and reduce inflammation, which could lead to serious illness; it also reduces depression, fatigue, and memory loss. description:
About the Pro JYM Protein Powder: Supported Goals: Muscle - Growth - Strength. What It Is: The perfect blend of three of the most effective types of proteins for building muscle: whey, micellar casein, and egg protein. The three types of protein are absorbed in the body at varying rates of speed – whey extremely fast, casein very slowly, and egg at a “medium” pace. This is exactly how you want your protein to act both before and after workouts to ensure that the muscles get an immediate supply of amino acids (the building blocks of protein) as well as a steady trickle of them in the hours following. Research now suggests that when you add medium-digesting and slow-digesting proteins to fast-digesting whey, muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for longer than when using whey alone. And muscle protein retention is higher, as well. That means that more protein is being built in the muscle. That is what may help lead to long-term gains in muscle growth and strength. What Sets It Apart: Aside from being a protein blend in a crowded market of sometimes underperforming 100% whey protein powders, Pro JYM is also a non-proprietary blend. A proprietary blend is any supplement that doesn't list the precise amount of every single active ingredient it contains. This isn’t just prevalent with pre-workouts and fat-burners – a lot of protein powders on the market are proprietary blends because they don’t tell you the exact amounts of the proteins in the formula. Pro JYM, on the other hand, lists the exact amounts on the front of the container of all three types of proteins in their four distinct forms: whey protein isolate (7.5 grams), micellar casein (7 grams), egg albumen (2.5 grams) and milk protein isolate (7 grams – 5.5 grams casein, 1.5 grams whey).

Nitrogen spiking (aka “amino spiking” or “protein spiking”) is an unscrupulous technique where some supplement companies put in less protein than what’s listed on the label as a means of slashing costs and increasing their protein margins – at the user’s expense. Getting a “spiked” protein means paying for, say, 24 grams of protein but getting only 18 grams of actual whole proteins. With Pro JYM, you get all 24 grams, guaranteed. Pro JYM is not and never will be spiked with cheap fillers.

description: Anabolic Whey is an engineered blend of ultrafiltered whey protein concentrates (containing lactoglobulin, lactoferrin, lactalbumin and immunoglobulin protein fractions), whey protein isolates, and complete milk proteins. We also added Glutamine and Taurine, two abundant amino acids in the human body. Milk proteins especially whey protein are the most popular bodybuilding proteins, no question about it. Also, they are among the highest quality protein sources. Determination of the nutritional efficiency of protein in the diet is in most cases based on estimating the extent to which dietary protein nitrogen is absorbed and retained by the body and is able to balance daily nitrogen losses. Net Protein Utilisation (NPU) is the percentage of ingested nitrogen that is retained in the body, and the Biological Value (BV) gives the percentage of absorbed nitrogen that is retained. Biological Value is the product of NPU and digestibility. Whey protein has good digestibility and amino acid composition, thus it's Biological Value is great compared to other dietary protein sources like meat, fish, eggs or soy. Anabolic is the physiological term for metabolic processes in the body that build up something. Dietary proteins are the source of nitrogen and indispensable amino acids, which the body requires for tissue growth and maintenance. description:
What Is Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate?

Whey is a substance produced during cheese production. It is the liquid content that remains after the milk has curdled and coagulated. Whey can be processed and isolated into three different types of protein: whey protein isolate, whey protein concentrate, and whey protein hydrolysate. This particular form of whey isolate is hydrolyzed, meaning that proteins are broken into small segments to promote rapid and easy digestion. Because of this, amino acid delivery into the bloodstream can be much faster than in typical whey protein.

description:
What Is Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate?

Whey is a substance produced during cheese production. It is the liquid content that remains after the milk has curdled and coagulated. Whey can be processed and isolated into three different types of protein: whey protein isolate, whey protein concentrate, and whey protein hydrolysate. This particular form of whey isolate is hydrolyzed, meaning that proteins are broken into small segments to promote rapid and easy digestion. Because of this, amino acid delivery into the bloodstream can be much faster than in typical whey protein.

Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate Benefits

Hydrolyzed whey protein isolate powder is a rich source of protein that may support muscle growth and aid in the recovery of exhausted muscles after anaerobic exercise.* This protein powder is also a rich source of leucine and branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs), essential amino acids that are largely found in muscle tissues and used primarily in the production of proteins.

description: Hydrolysis is the natural intestinal process of breaking down whole proteins found in food and supplements into smaller proteins, called peptides (Micro Peptides), and amino acids. DH is the Degree of Hydrolysis, which indicates the extent to which the protein has been broken down. Higher DH means more rapid and complete absorption. In order to be absorbed, protein must be hydrolyzed down to amino acids or to the smallest peptides, called di and tripeptides. Whole proteins, including whey isolates, concentrates, caseins, soy, and blends are large proteins and naturally contain little to no Micro Peptides, and no di and tripeptides. Proto Whey is 100% Micro Peptides, of which, up to 40% are di and tripeptides. Targeted Protein DeliveryThe di and tripeptides in Proto Whey target the PEPT-1 transporter which transports over 8,400 different di and tripeptides. Whole protein digestion relies heavily on amino acid transporters which are far more specific and transport only a fraction of what PEPT-1 transporters do. The speed and efficiency of the PEPT-1 transport system allows for faster delivery of protein throughout the body and bypasses other systems that can limit the delivery of amino acids. Di and tripeptides carry metabolic information not present in amino acids. High-DH proteins deliver protein into the blood primarily as di and tripeptides whereas whole protein digestion often results in single amino acids. More Proto Whey Advantages+ Requires less breakdown and digestive energy than whole proteins. + Contains 10 grams of essential amino acids per serving. EAAs cannot be synthesized by the body and must be supplied by the diet. + Employs DEM (digestive energy matrix), a unique combination of SoftPsil micronized psyllium finer and MCTs (medium chain triglycerides) to provide digestive energy and help maintain optimum intestinal health. + High-DH reduces ...

description: Hydrolysis is the natural intestinal process of breaking down whole proteins found in food and supplements into smaller proteins, called peptides (Micro Peptides), and amino acids. DH is the Degree of Hydrolysis, which indicates the extent to which the protein has been broken down. Higher DH means more rapid and complete absorption. In order to be absorbed, protein must be hydrolyzed down to amino acids or to the smallest peptides, called di and tripeptides. Whole proteins, including whey isolates, concentrates, caseins, soy, and blends are large proteins and naturally contain little to no Micro Peptides, and no di and tripeptides. Proto Whey is 100% Micro Peptides, of which, up to 40% are di and tripeptides. Targeted Protein DeliveryThe di and tripeptides in Proto Whey target the PEPT-1 transporter which transports over 8,400 different di and tripeptides. Whole protein digestion relies heavily on amino acid transporters which are far more specific and transport only a fraction of what PEPT-1 transporters do. The speed and efficiency of the PEPT-1 transport system allows for faster delivery of protein throughout the body and bypasses other systems that can limit the delivery of amino acids. Di and tripeptides carry metabolic information not present in amino acids. High-DH proteins deliver protein into the blood primarily as di and tripeptides whereas whole protein digestion often results in single amino acids. Casein protein powder is a protein derived from milk. Milk contains two types of protein: casein and whey. Casein protein is slow-digesting, which means it releases amino acids slowly instead of quickly like whey. Casein protein is often taken before periods of rest and sleep.

description:
The Ketogenic diet should be easy to stick with, but in a carb-run world, things can get tricky. While everyone is different, we are all fundamentally very similar. Our bodies were not designed to run on carbohydrates as a primary food source, especially refined ones like sugar and flour. Instead, our bodies are genetically programmed to use fat and protein to get energy.

Additionally, when following the ketogenic diet, people often lose hard-earned muscle as quickly as fat. With the low amount of protein required by the ketogenic diet, it’s hard to meet the protein demands of growing muscles. A diet needs to become a lifestyle, a way of eating that ensures the weight stays off and your new look stays on. If you can’t stick to the diet and turn it into a lifestyle, then what is the use? We at Purus Labs ran into similar problems, and decided to do something to make things a little easier on ourselves and our fellow Ketogenic dieters. Enter, KetoFeed.

Lose The Weight, Not The Muscle

With KetoFeed, we knew that we had to up the protein intake for the average athlete. However, we didn’t want the protein intake to be high enough to spike insulin levels and mess with the athlete’s ability to keep shedding body fat.

We added 20g of high quality whey protein, filtered to remove all sugar, and to make sure that the protein didn't mess with the athletes’ fat-loss goals, we combined the protein with THE crucial component of the keto diet, FAT! MCT(medium chain triglyceride) fat, to be exact. The same type of fat that makes coconuts so healthy for you. This same MCT fat slows down the absorption of the protein and prevents it from spiking insulin levels.

KetoFeed helps the body to maintain muscle with clean protein, burn fat for fuel and gather energy from MCTs. It’s an important tool for anyone participating in the ketogenic diet (or lifestyle) to have in his or her arsenal.

description:
About the Pro JYM Protein Powder

Supported Goals: Muscle - Growth - Strength

What It Is: The perfect blend of three of the most effective types of proteins for building muscle: whey, micellar casein, and egg protein. The three types of protein are absorbed in the body at varying rates of speed – whey extremely fast, casein very slowly, and egg at a “medium” pace. This is exactly how you want your protein to act both before and after workouts to ensure that the muscles get an immediate supply of amino acids (the building blocks of protein) as well as a steady trickle of them in the hours following.

Research now suggests that when you add medium-digesting and slow-digesting proteins to fast-digesting whey, muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for longer than when using whey alone. And muscle protein retention is higher, as well. That means that more protein is being built in the muscle. That is what may help lead to long-term gains in muscle growth and strength.

Each serving of Pro JYM provides 24 grams Protein:
- 7.5g Whey Protein Isolate
- 7g Micellar Casein
- 7g Milk Protein Isolate
- 2.5g Egg White Protein

What Sets It Apart: Aside from being a protein blend in a crowded market of sometimes underperforming 100% whey protein powders, Pro JYM is also a non-proprietary blend. A proprietary blend is any supplement that doesn't list the precise amount of every single active ingredient it contains. This isn’t just prevalent with pre-workouts and fat-burners – a lot of protein powders on the market are proprietary blends because they don’t tell you the exact amounts of the proteins in the formula. Pro JYM, on the other hand, lists the exact amounts on the front of the container of all three types of proteins in their four distinct forms: whey protein isolate (7.5 grams), micellar casein (7 grams), egg albumen (2.5 grams) and milk protein isolate (7 grams – 5.5 grams casein, 1.5 grams whey). 

Nitrogen spiking (aka “amino spiking” or “protein spiking”) is an unscrupulous technique where some supplement companies put in less protein than what’s listed on the label as a means of slashing costs and increasing their protein margins – at the user’s expense. Getting a “spiked” protein means paying for, say, 24 grams of protein but getting only 18 grams of actual whole proteins. With Pro JYM, you get all 24 grams, guaranteed. Pro JYM is not and never will be spiked with cheap fillers.

كشركة وقود رياضية، نركز على توسيع عروض منتجاتنا لتزويد الرياضيين بأشكال متعددة من المنتجات المدعومة بالعلم والتي يمكن أن تساعد على زيادة أدائهم.



ما الذي أدى جاتوريد إلى إنتاج منتجات بروتين بأقل المكونات؟



أثناء العمل مع الرياضيين المحترفين والجامعيين والمدربين الرياضيين ومدربي القوة والتكييف وأخصائيي التغذية المسجلة، فقد علمنا أن بعض الرياضيين يفضلون المنتجات بمكونات صناعية أقل.



تضع جاتوريد الرياضيين أولاً. نظرًا لتفضيلاتهم واحتياجاتهم إلى التغيير، فإننا نبحث عن حلول جديدة لإنشاء منتجات تلبي متطلباتهم الفريدة قبل وأثناء وبعد النشاط.



في حين أنه لا يوجد فائدة رياضية مثبتة في وجود مكونات أقل، فإننا نريد أن نكون قادرين على تزويد الرياضيين بالمرونة لتخصيص التغذية الخاصة بهم للمساعدة في تحقيق أهدافهم الفريدة.



لماذا يعتبر البروتين مهمًا؟



البروتين هو جزء مهم من تعافي العضلات ويساعد على إعادة بناء العضلات عند استهلاكها بعد التمرين. جميع مساحيق البروتين جي إسنشل مصنوعة من بروتينات عالية الجودة و"كاملة" مما يعني أنها تحتوي على جميع الأحماض الأمينية الأساسية التي لا يستطيع الجسم صنعها بمفردها.



ما هو المختلف عن بروتين مصل اللبن المعزول ؟

مصل اللبن المعزول هو من بين أنقى أشكال بروتين مصل الحليب المتاحة. إنه بروتين عالي الجودة وسريع الامتصاص يحتوي على جميع الأحماض الأمينية الأساسية التي لا يستطيع الجسم صنعها بمفرده.

بروتين مصل اللبن المعزول هو مصدر جيد للأحماض الأمينية المتفرعة (BCAA) والليوسين، وهو حمض أميني رئيسي يشارك في تحفيز إنتاج بروتين العضلات. كما أنها منخفضة الدهون مقارنةً بأنواع أخرى من بروتين مصل الحليب.

مسحوق بروتين جي إيستل واي المعزول مصنوع بدون سكر أو نكهات صناعية أو محليات.

G ESSNTL은 알아볼 수 있는 재료로 만든 새로운 제품 라인입니다 - 운동 선수와 운동자에게 목표, 선호도 및 활동에 따라 다양한 연료 옵션을 제공합니다.

G ESSNTL 단백질이 다른 이유는 무엇입니까?



G ESSNTL은 인식하기 쉬운 최소한의 성분으로 만들어져 운동 선수들의 목표, 선호도 및 활동에 따라 다양한 연료 옵션을 제공합니다.



스포츠 연료 회사로서, 저희는 운동 선수들의 성과를 극대화하는 데 도움이 되는 다양한 형태의 과학 지원 제품을 제공하기 위해 제품 제공을 확장하는 데 초점을 맞추고 있습니다.



최소한의 성분으로 단백질 제품을 만들기 위해 Gatorade는 무엇이 이었을까요?



전문 및 대학 운동 선수, 운동 트레이너, 근력 및 컨디셔닝 코치 및 등록 영양사와 협력하면서 일부 운동 선수들은 인공 성분이 적은 제품을 선호한다는 것을 배웠습니다.



게토레이드는 운동 선수를 최우선으로 합니다. 선호도와 요구 사항이 변화함에 따라 활동 전, 활동 중, 후에 고유한 요구 사항을 충족하는 제품을 만들기 위한 새로운 솔루션을 찾습니다.



성분을 적게 섭취하는 것으로 입증된 운동적 이점은 없지만, 저희는 운동 선수들이 자신의 독특한 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 영양을 맞춤화할 수 있는 유연성을 제공하고자 합니다.



단백질이 중요한 이유는 무엇입니까?



단백질은 중요한 부분 회복이며 운동 후 섭취하면 근육을 재구성하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 모든 G ESSNTL 단백질 파우더는 고품질의 "완벽한" 단백질로 만들어져 신체가 자체적으로 만들 수 없는 필수 아미노산을 모두 함유하고 있습니다.



분리 유청 단백질의 차이점은 무엇입니까?

분리 유청은 사용 가능한 가장 순수한 유청 단백질 중 하나입니다. 몸이 자체적으로 만들 수 없는 필수 아미노산을 모두 함유한 고품질의 빠르게 흡수하는 단백질입니다.

분리 유청 단백질은 근육 단백질 합성을 촉진하는 핵심 아미노산인 분지 사슬 아미노산(BCAA)과 류신의 좋은 공급원입니다. 다른 유형의 유청 단백질에 비해 지방이 낮습니다.

Pure High-DH Hydrolyzed Whey Protein. DH is the Degree of Hydrolysis, which indicates the extent to which the protein has been broken down. Higher DH means more rapid and complete absorption. In order to be absorbed, protein must be hydrolyzed down to amino acids or to the smallest peptides, called di and tripeptides. Whole proteins, including whey isolates, concentrates, caseins, soy, and blends are large proteins and naturally contain little to no Micro Peptides, and no di and tripeptides. Proto Whey is 100% Micro Peptides, of which, up to 40% are di and tripeptides. Targeted Protein Delivery. The di and tripeptides in Proto Whey target the PEPT-1 transporter which transports over 8,400 different di and tripeptides. Whole protein digestion relies heavily on amino acid transporters which are far more specific and transport only a fraction of what PEPT-1 transporters do. The speed and efficiency of the PEPT-1 transport system allows for faster delivery of protein throughout the body and bypasses other systems that can limit the delivery of amino acids. Di and tripeptides carry metabolic information not present in amino acids. High-DH proteins delivery protein into the blood primarily as di and tripeptides whereas whole protein digestion often results in single amino acids. More Proto Whey Advantages. Requires less breakdown and digestive energy than whole proteins. Contains 10 grams of essential amino acids per serving. EAAs cannot be synthesized by the body and must be supplied by the diet.. Employs DEM (digestive energy matrix), a unique combination of SoftPsil micronized psyllium fiber and MCTs (medium chain triglycerides) to provide digestive energy and help maintain optimum intestinal health. High-DH reduces allergenicity. Low glycemic response. Mixes easily - no blender required. Industry-leading, rich and creamy taste profile.

description:
BNRG Power Crunch Proto Whey - Double Chocolate - 5.3 lbs (2.41kg)

Pure High-DH Hydrolyzed Whey Protein. DH is the Degree of Hydrolysis, which indicates the extent to which the protein has been broken down. Higher DH means more rapid and complete absorption. In order to be absorbed, protein must be hydrolyzed down to amino acids or to the smallest peptides, called di and tripeptides. Whole proteins, including whey isolates, concentrates, caseins, soy, and blends are large proteins and naturally contain little to no Micro Peptides, and no di and tripeptides. Proto Whey is 100% Micro Peptides, of which, up to 40% are di and tripeptides. Targeted Protein Delivery. The di and tripeptides in Proto Whey target the PEPT-1 transporter which transports over 8,400 different di and tripeptides. Whole protein digestion relies heavily on amino acid transporters which are far more specific and transport only a fraction of what PEPT-1 transporters do. The speed and efficiency of the PEPT-1 transport system allows for faster delivery of protein throughout the body and bypasses other systems that can limit the delivery of amino acids. Di and tripeptides carry metabolic information not present in amino acids. High-DH proteins delivery protein into the blood primarily as di and tripeptides whereas whole protein digestion often results in single amino acids. More Proto Whey Advantages. Requires less breakdown and digestive energy than whole proteins. Contains 10 grams of essential amino acids per serving. EAAs cannot be synthesized by the body and must be supplied by the diet.. Employs DEM (digestive energy matrix), a unique combination of SoftPsil micronized psyllium fiber and MCTs (medium chain triglycerides) to provide digestive energy and help maintain optimum intestinal health. High-DH reduces allergenicity. Low glycemic response. Mixes easily - no blender required. Industry-leading, rich and creamy taste profile.

What Is Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate?

Whey is a substance produced during cheese production. It is the liquid content that remains after the milk has curdled and coagulated. Whey can be processed and isolated into three different types of protein: whey protein isolate, whey protein concentrate, and whey protein hydrolysate. description: True Nutrition’s Whey Protein Isolate Microfiltration is derived from whey protein concentrate, but ultimately from sweet dairy whey. Whey Protein Isolates, including Whey Protein Isolate Microfiltration, Whey Protein Isolate Cold-Filtration, are protein powders that are the next steps to further process whey protein concentrate. The Microfiltration process is a procedure of separating the proteins through the use of filters. These filters allow the protein to be removed from the unwanted fat, lactose and the like. Microfiltration Isolate is virtually fat free and lactose (sugar) free. Whereas the harmful Ion-Exchange process uses electrical charge and chemicals to extract the protein, Microfiltration uses a more natural way of extracting protein through filters that do not have the same harmful effects in denaturing the bioactive ingredients. Microfiltered isolates are left with more calcium and give the user the highest level of undenatured protein available in a whey protein isolate. The extraction process leaves the final product almost all protein, around 90% protein. Whey Protein Isolate Microfiltration is a great whey protein for users who experience bloating and other problems associated with whey protein concentrate. نحن نؤمن بأن النظام الغذائي النباتي يجعل الصحة المثلى للجميع. التغذية الصحيحة عالمية، ولكن قصتك وجسمك فريدان من نوعهما. لهذا السبب قمنا بتصميم في برو ليناسب تنوع نمط حياتك وتقديم كل التغذية التي تحتاجها، في مزيج واحد مريح. ادعم رحلتك إلى الصحة مع في برو، واجعل الحياة أفضل. مصممة بشكل مثالي لتوفر جميع البروتينات النباتية والفيتامينات الأساسية والمعادن. لقد أجرينا الأبحاث من أجلك، حتى تتمكن من النمو في نمط حياة نباتي. يساعدك على الحفاظ على تركيزك ونشاطك وتعزيز تدريباتك حتى تتمكن من التفوق وتبقيك راضيًا وتخلصك من التوتر. 6 مصادر من بروتين النبات الخام توفر المزيج الصحيح من الفيتامينات والمعادن التي يحتاجها جسمك. بدلاً من تقييد مصادرنا بأشياء مثل بروتين البازلاء المعزول ، فإننا نصنع كل مزيج بعناية باستخدام حكمة الطبيعة. يتضمن الشكل الشامل للمكونات في برو 6 مصادر نباتية خام لتوفير التغذية الصحيحة: سبيرولينا تعبئة 22 حمضًا أمينيًا، والمعادن النادرة الأساسية، وما يصل إلى 70% من وزنها في البروتين، سبيرولينا هي مصدر طاقة غذائية يحصل على العنوان الفائق. أرتيخانق محملة بالمغذيات النباتية، توفر أرشوكا مصدر منخفض الدهون والكوليسترول منخفض السعرات الحرارية. الكينوا الغني بالألياف والمغنيسيوم وفيتامينات بي والحديد والبوتاسيوم والكالسيوم والفوسفور وفيتامين E وأكثر من ذلك، كينوا هي عبوة رائعة متعددة الفيتامينات. بالإضافة إلى ذلك، تحتوي على 8 جرامات من البروتين لكل كوب! نبات الأمارانث كحبيبات قديمة، يوفر زيت المارانث جميع الأحماض الأمينية التسعة الأساسية، مما يجعله مصدراً كاملاً للبروتين. البازلاء الصديقة للقلب غنية بالأرجينين الذي يدعم نمو العضلات والدورة الدموية. كما توفر البازلاء جميع الأحماض الأمينية التسعة الأساسية. الأرز البني هو مصدر بروتين أساسي لا يسبب الحساسية، الأرز البني خالٍ من الغلوتين ومنخفض الكوليسترول بينما غني بالمنغنيز والسيلينيوم والفوسفور.

Você não precisa de produtos animais para saborear os muitos benefícios da proteína. Aproveitamos o perfurador de proteína de ervilha para veganos e indivíduos ativos que desejam o máximo de seus suplementos. A equipe de pesquisa e desenvolvimento Pure Vegan tem o orgulho de apresentar uma nova geração de proteínas derivadas do isolamento de proteína de ervilha da mais alta qualidade. Esta recente revolução na tecnologia de proteína rivaliza com as proteínas de soro de leite em pó mais populares devido ao seu impressionante perfil de aminoácidos e valor biológico. Em outras palavras, a proteína isolada de ervilha pode produzir gramas mais utilizáveis de aminoácidos em comparação com outras proteínas. Além disso, a proteína de ervilha vegana pura é uma proteína completa adequada para vegetarianos. É livre de lactose e colesterol, mas não contém sabores artificiais ou adoçantes. Os desejos constantes por alimentos vazios de calorias como carboidratos, doces, cafeína, chocolate, pop, doces, ou lascas apontam para o açúcar no sangue instável. Nem todos com desejo são deficientes de proteína, mas deficiência de proteína e açúcar no sangue instável estão intimamente ligados. A proteína pura vegana isolada é uma mistura de proteína derivada de grãos de ervilha dourados. O Pure Vegan usa uma forma isolada de proteína de ervilha, pois contém uma proporção impressionante de aminoácidos essenciais e não essenciais, bem como uma alta concentração de aminoácidos de cadeia ramificada. Estes aminoácidos compensam as deficiências comuns em uma dieta vegetariana e são conhecidos por reduzir a gordura corporal e aumentar a massa muscular magra. Da mesma forma, a proteína isolada de ervilha pode melhorar a retenção de nitrogênio para crescimento e reparo muscular. A proteína isolada de ervilha pode ser facilmente incorporada em alimentos como pudim, panquecas, muffins, iogurte, cereais quentes e bebidas de vitaminas. Nossas proteínas de ervilha sabor suave são leves e refrescantes, deixando uma sensação de saciedade após o consumo. Ao contrário dos populares pós de proteína de soro de leite, a proteína de ervilha é facilmente digerida, já que não contém absolutamente lactose ou glútens. Portanto, não há inchaço, uma desvantagem comumente ligada a produtos populares de proteína de soro. A proteína de ervilha é projetada para pessoas de todas as idades. É uma ótima fonte de proteína para dietas com baixo teor de carboidratos, vegetarianos, atletas, crianças ou qualquer pessoa que sinta a necessidade de adicionar proteína adicional à sua dieta. Como pode ser misturada com uma colher, a proteína de ervilha vegana pura pode ser transformada em um shake rico e cremoso praticamente qualquer lugar, eliminando a necessidade de liquidificadores manuais ou volumosos. Todos os produtos Pure Vegan são criados em uma instalação regulamentada pela FDA em equipamentos de embalagem veganos dedicados que nunca tocaram nenhuma matéria-prima não vegana. Para sua saúde não contém absolutamente adoçantes, sabores, cores, glúten, soja, lactose, ou conservantes. O vegano puro é incomparável em potência, qualidade e pureza. Todos os lotes de matérias-primas são testados quanto à pureza e potência dentro da equipe de garantia de qualidade Pure Vegans, controle de qualidade e pesquisa e desenvolvimento. A proteína de ervilha não contém sabores artificiais ou adoçantes. Estudos revelaram que adoçantes artificiais populares comumente usados em alimentos com baixo teor de carboidratos têm sido relatados que causaram desconforto gastrointestinal. Já que a Pure Vegan usa apenas ingredientes naturais, a maioria das pessoas alérgicas a sabores artificiais ou adoçantes podem consumir com segurança proteína de ervilha. description:
THE STORY:
We love eggs.
They have a great nutritional profile - ideal for any active individual. They taste great when cooked and are used as part of many healthy nutritious recipes.

One thing they aren’t, however, is convenient for your average training day. They break in your gym bag, don’t stay still on flat surfaces and, let’s be honest, are pretty disgusting if eaten raw.

After a good while playing with this technology we ended up with an egg white protein powder that has no taste to it. With just a few additional ingredients, we turned our egg whites into chocolate milk (with no milk or lactose in sight).

==> Step 1: We extract egg whites from eggs, then use a new technology to filter out substances that taste bad.
==> Step 2: We then spray the egg whites to create an eggy mist that dries into a powder.

==> Step 4: We then blend the powder with cocoa, organic cane sugar, a natural chocolate flavouring and a little salt to get the taste right.
==> Step 5: Lastly we add a gum extract from the guar bean to thicken the final shake, giving it that real chocolate milk-like consistency. Yum!


We developed this product with the active individual in mind. It is not intended to be a weight loss supplement. G ESSNTL מיוצר עם מרכיבים מינימליים שקל לזהות – מה שנותן לספורטאים מגוון רחב של אפשרויות תדלוק בהתבסס על המטרות, העדפה ופעילות. כחברת דלק ספורט, אנו מתמקדים בהרחבת הצעות המוצרים שלנו כדי לספק לספורטאים צורות שונות של מוצרים בעלי גיבוי מדעי שיכולים לעזור למקסם את הביצועים שלהם. מה הוביל Gatorade ליצירת מוצרי חלבון עם מרכיבים מינימליים? תוך כדי עבודה עם ספורטאים מקצועיים ומכללות, מאמני אתלטיקה, מאמני כוח וריכוך ודיאטנים רשומים, למדנו כי ספורטאים מסוימים מעדיפים מוצרים עם פחות מרכיבים מלאכותיים. Gatorade שם אתלטים קודם. ככל שהעדפותיהם וצרכיהם משתנים, אנו מחפשים פתרונות חדשים כדי ליצור מוצרים העונים על הדרישות הייחודיות שלהם לפני, במהלך ואחרי פעילות. למרות שאין יתרון אתלטי מוכח שיש פחות מרכיבים, אנחנו רוצים להיות מסוגלים לספק לספורטאים את הגמישות להתאים אישית את התזונה שלהם כדי לעזור לענות על המטרות הייחודיות שלהם. למה חלבון חשוב? חלבון הוא שחזור חלק חשוב ועוזר לשקם את השרירים בעת השימוש לאחר אימון. כל אבקות החלבון G ESSNTL מיוצרות עם חלבונים "שלמים", כלומר הן מכילות את כל חומצות האמינו החיוניות שהגוף לא יכול לייצר בכוחות עצמו. מה שונה בחלבון מי גבינה מבודד? מי גבינה מבודד הוא בין הצורות הטהורות ביותר של חלבון מי גבינה שזמין. הוא באיכות גבוהה, סופג במהירות חלבון המכיל את כל חומצות האמינו החיוניות שהגוף לא יכול לייצר בכוחות עצמו. חלבון מי גבינה מבודד הוא מקור טוב לחומצות אמינו מסועפות בשרשרת (BCAA) ולאוצין, חומצת אמינו עיקרית המעורבת בסינתזת חלבון שרירים. הם גם נמוכים בשומן בהשוואה לסוגים אחרים של חלבון מי גבינה. אבקת חלבון מי גבינה מבודדת G ESSNTL מיוצרת ללא תוספת סוכרים, טעמים מלאכותיים או ממתיקים.

Minimale Inhaltsstoffe Maximale Ergebnisse. Whey Isolate Proteinpulver wird mit hochwertigem Whey Protein Isolat hergestellt, um den Muskelaufbau nach sportlicher Aktivität zu helfen. Es ist ein schnell absorbierendes, komplettes Protein, das alle essentiellen Aminosäuren liefert, die der Körper nicht alleine herstellen kann. Was ist G ESSNTL? G ESSNTL ist eine neue Linie von Produkten mit erkennbaren Inhaltsstoffen – bietet Athleten und Sportlern eine breite Palette von Kraftstoffoptionen, basierend auf ihren Zielen, Vorlieben und Aktivitäten. G ESSNTL entwickelt ein umfassendes Produktportfolio einschließlich einer Reihe von Hydratations- und Sportkraftstoffprodukten. Das Produktportfolio ermöglicht eine einfache Anpassung und präzise Portionierung, um in verschiedene Ernährungsprogramme zu passen und kann in Verbindung mit vorhandenen Gatorade-Produkten verwendet werden. Was macht G ESSNTL Protein anders? G ESSNTL wird mit minimalen Inhaltsstoffen hergestellt, die leicht zu erkennen sind – bietet Athleten eine breite Palette von Kraftstoffoptionen basierend auf ihren Zielen, Vorlieben und Aktivitäten. Als Sportkraftstoff-Unternehmen konzentrieren wir uns darauf, unsere Produktangebote zu erweitern, um Athleten mit mehreren Formen von wissenschaftlich unterstützten Produkten zu versorgen, die dabei helfen können, ihre Leistung zu maximieren. Was hat Gatorade dazu geführt, Proteinprodukte mit minimalen Inhaltsstoffen zu kreieren? Während wir mit professionellen und College-Sportlern, Athletiktrainern, Kraft- und Konditionstrainern und registrierten Dietitiern arbeiten, haben wir gelernt, dass einige Athleten Produkte mit weniger künstlichen Inhaltsstoffen bevorzugen. Gatorade setzt Sportler an erster Stelle. Wenn sich ihre Vorlieben und Bedürfnisse ändern, suchen wir nach neuen Lösungen, um Produkte zu schaffen, die ihren einzigartigen Anforderungen vor, während und nach der Aktivität entsprechen. Obwohl es keinen nachgewiesenen athletischen Vorteil gibt, weniger Zutaten zu haben, wollen wir Athleten die Flexibilität bieten, ihre Ernährung anzupassen, um ihre einzigartigen Ziele zu erreichen. Warum ist Protein wichtig? Protein ist ein wichtiger Teil der Regeneration und hilft beim Wiederaufbau der Muskeln nach dem Training. Alle G ESSNTL Proteinpulver werden mit hochwertigen und "kompletten" Proteinen hergestellt, d.h. sie enthalten alle essentiellen Aminosäuren, die der Körper nicht alleine herstellen kann. Was unterscheidet sich am Whey Isolat Protein? Whey Isolat gehört zu den reinsten Formen des verfügbaren Molkenproteins. Es ist ein hochwertiges, schnell absorbierendes Protein mit allen essentiellen Aminosäuren, die der Körper nicht alleine herstellen kann. Whey Isolat Protein ist eine gute Quelle von verzweigtkettigen Aminosäuren (BCAA) und Leucin, eine Schlüsselaminosäure, die an der Auslösung der Muskelproteinsynthese beteiligt ist. Außerdem sind sie fettarm im Vergleich zu anderen Molkenproteinarten. G ESSNTL Whey Isolate Protein Pulver wird ohne Zusatz von Zucker, künstlichen Aromen oder Süßungsmitteln hergestellt.

Ingredientes mínimos. Resultados máximos. Whey Isolate Protein Powder é feito com proteína de soro de leite isolada de alta qualidade para ajudar a reconstruir os músculos após atividade atlética. É uma proteína rápida e completa que oferece todos os aminoácidos essenciais que o corpo não pode fazer sozinho. O que é a G ESSNTL? G ESSNTL é uma nova linha de produtos feita com ingredientes reconhecidos – dando a atletas e exercícios uma ampla variedade de opções de combustível com base em seus objetivos, preferências e atividades. A G ESSNTL está desenvolvendo um portfólio de produtos de gama completa incluindo uma série de produtos de hidratação e combustível esportivo. O portfólio de produtos permite fácil personalização e porções precisas para se encaixar em vários regimes nutricionais e pode ser usado em conjunto com produtos Gatorade existentes. O que torna a proteína G ESSNTL diferente? G ESSNTL é feito com ingredientes mínimos que são fáceis de reconhecer – dando aos atletas uma ampla variedade de opções de combustível com base em seus objetivos, preferência e atividade. Como uma empresa de combustível esportivo, estamos focando em expandir nossas ofertas de produtos para oferecer aos atletas várias formas de produtos apoiados pela ciência que podem ajudar a maximizar seu desempenho. O que levou a Gatorade para criar produtos de proteína com ingredientes mínimos? Enquanto trabalha com atletas profissionais e universitários, treinadores atléticos, treinadores de força e condicionamento e nutricionistas registrados, aprendemos que alguns atletas preferem produtos com menos ingredientes artificiais. A Gatorade coloca os atletas em primeiro lugar. Conforme suas preferências e necessidades mudam, buscamos novas soluções para criar produtos que atendam aos seus requisitos exclusivos antes, durante e após a atividade. Embora não haja benefícios atléticos comprovados em ter menos ingredientes, queremos ser capazes de fornecer aos atletas a flexibilidade para personalizar sua nutrição para ajudar a alcançar seus objetivos únicos. Por que a proteína é importante? A proteína é uma parte importante de recuperação e ajuda a reconstruir os músculos quando consumida após um treino. Todas as proteínas em pó G ESSNTL são feitas com proteínas de alta qualidade e "completas", o que significa que contêm todos os aminoácidos essenciais que o corpo não pode fazer sozinho. O que há de diferente sobre a proteína isolada de soro? Whey isolate está entre as formas mais puras de proteína de soro de leite disponível. É uma proteína de alta qualidade, de rápida absorção contendo todos os aminoácidos essenciais que o corpo não pode fazer sozinho. A proteína Whey isolate é uma boa fonte de aminoácidos de cadeia ramificada (BCAA) e leucina, um aminoácido chave envolvido no desencadear a síntese de proteína muscular. Eles também têm baixo teor de gordura em comparação com outros tipos de proteína de soro de leite. O pó de proteína Whey Isolate da G ESSNTL é feito sem açúcares, sabores artificiais ou adoçantes.

基本成分。 效果更佳。 乳清分离蛋白粉采用优质乳清蛋白分离物制成,有助于运动后重建肌肉。 它是一种快速吸收的完整蛋白质,提供身体无法自行生成的所有必需氨基酸。 什么是 G ESSNTL? G ESSNTL 是一款采用可识别成分制成的全新产品系列 - 根据运动员和运动员的目标、偏好和活动,提供各种燃料选择。 G ESSNTL 正在开发一个全系列的产品组合,包括大量保湿和运动燃料产品。 产品组合可轻松定制和精确分配,以适应各种营养方案,并可与现有的佳得乐产品配合使用。 G ESSNTL蛋白有什么不同? G ESSNTL 采用易于识别的最低成分制成 - 根据运动员的目标、偏好和活动,提供各种燃料选择。 作为一家体育燃料公司,我们专注于拓展我们的产品,为运动员提供多种形式的科学支持产品,以帮助最大限度地提高他们的表现。 是什么让佳得乐创造含有最少成分的蛋白质产品? 当与专业和大学运动员、运动教练、力量和调理教练以及注册的营养师合作时,我们了解到一些运动员喜欢较少人工配料的产品。 佳得乐将运动员放在首位。 随着他们的偏好和需求变化,我们寻找新的解决方案来创造满足他们独特要求的产品。 虽然配料较少,但没有被证明的运动好处,我们希望能够为运动员提供灵活性,定制他们的营养,以帮助达到他们独特的目标。 为什么蛋白质很重要? 蛋白质是恢复重要的一部分,有助于锻炼后食用重建肌肉。 所有 G ESSNTL 蛋白粉均采用优质"完整"蛋白质制成,这意味着它们含有人体无法自行制造的所有必需氨基酸。 乳清分离蛋白有什么不同? 乳清分离物是最纯净的乳清蛋白形式之一。 它是一种高品质、快速吸收的蛋白质,含有人体无法自行生成的所有必需氨基酸。 乳清分离蛋白是支链氨基酸(BCAA)和亮氨酸的良好来源,一种参与触发肌肉蛋白质合成的关键氨基酸。 与其他类型的乳清蛋白相比,它们的脂肪也很低。 G ESSNTL 乳清分离蛋白粉不含糖、人工香料或甜味剂。

最低成分。 效果最佳。 Whey Isolate 蛋白粉採用高品質分離乳清蛋白製成,有助於在運動後重建肌肉。 這是一種快速吸收、完整的蛋白質,提供身體無法自行製作的所有必需氨基酸。 ​ 什麼是 G ESSNTL? G ESSNTL 是採用可識別成分製成的新系列產品 - 根據運動員的目標、喜好和活動,為運動員和鍛煉者提供廣泛的加油選擇。 G ESSNTL 正在開發全系列產品組合,包括多種保濕和運動燃料產品。 產品組合可讓您輕鬆客製化,並精確分段,以深入各種營養方案,並可與現有的 Gatorade 產品一起使用。 什麼讓 G ESSNTL 蛋白與眾不同? G ESSNTL 採用易於識別的最少成分製成——根據運動員的目標、喜好和活動提供各種燃料選項。 作為一家運動燃料公司,我們專注於擴展我們的產品,為運動員提供多種形式的科學支持產品,有助於他們最大程度地提高表現。 是什麼讓 Gatorade 以最小的成分創造蛋白質產品? 在與專業和大學運動員、運動教練、力量和調理教練以及註冊營養師合作的同時,我們了解到有些運動員更喜歡使用較少的人工成分的產品。 Gatorade 將運動員放在第一位。 隨著他們的喜好和需求的變化,我們尋找新的解決方案來創造符合他們活動前、期間和之後的獨特需求的產品。 雖然使用更少的成分沒有證實的運動益處,但我們希望能夠為運動員提供靈活性,以定制他們的營養,幫助實現他們獨特的目標。 為什麼蛋白質很重要? 蛋白質是恢復的重要部分,有助於在鍛煉後消耗肌肉重建。 ​ 所有 G ESSNTL 蛋白粉均採用高品質和「完整」蛋白質製成,這意味著它們含有身體無法自行製作的所有必需氨基酸。 分離乳清蛋白有什麼不同? 乳清分離蛋白是最純淨的乳清蛋白。 它是一種高品質、快速吸收的蛋白質,含有身體無法自行製造的所有必需氨基酸。 ​ 乳清分離蛋白是支鏈氨基酸 (BCAA) 和亮氨酸的良好來源,這是一種促進肌肉蛋白質合成的關鍵氨基酸。 與其他類型的乳清蛋白相比,它們的脂肪也低。 G ESSNTL 乳清分離蛋白粉不含糖、人工香料或甜味劑。

최소한의 성분. 최대 결과. 분리 유청 단백질 파우더는 운동 후 근육을 재건하는 데 도움이 되도록 고품질 유청 단백질로 만들어졌습니다. 빠르게 흡수되고 완전한 단백질로 신체가 자체적으로 만들 수 없는 필수 아미노산을 모두 제공합니다. G ESSNTL이란 무엇입니까? G ESSNTL은 알아볼 수 있는 재료로 만든 새로운 제품 라인입니다 - 운동 선수와 운동자에게 목표, 선호도 및 활동에 따라 다양한 연료 옵션을 제공합니다. G ESSNTL은 다양한 수분 및 스포츠 연료 제품을 포함한 전체 제품 포트폴리오를 개발하고 있습니다. 제품 포트폴리오는 다양한 영양 요법에 맞게 쉽게 커스터마이징할 수 있으며 기존 Gatorade 제품과 함께 사용할 수 있습니다. G ESSNTL 단백질이 다른 이유는 무엇입니까? G ESSNTL은 인식하기 쉬운 최소한의 성분으로 만들어져 운동 선수들의 목표, 선호도 및 활동에 따라 다양한 연료 옵션을 제공합니다. 스포츠 연료 회사로서, 저희는 운동 선수들의 성과를 극대화하는 데 도움이 되는 다양한 형태의 과학 지원 제품을 제공하기 위해 제품 제공을 확장하는 데 초점을 맞추고 있습니다. 최소한의 성분으로 단백질 제품을 만들기 위해 Gatorade는 무엇이 이었을까요? 전문 및 대학 운동 선수, 운동 트레이너, 근력 및 컨디셔닝 코치 및 등록 영양사와 협력하면서 일부 운동 선수들은 인공 성분이 적은 제품을 선호한다는 것을 배웠습니다. 게토레이드는 운동 선수를 최우선으로 합니다. 선호도와 요구 사항이 변화함에 따라 활동 전, 활동 중, 후에 고유한 요구 사항을 충족하는 제품을 만들기 위한 새로운 솔루션을 찾습니다. 성분을 적게 섭취하는 것으로 입증된 운동적 이점은 없지만, 저희는 운동 선수들이 자신의 독특한 목표를 달성할 수 있도록 영양을 맞춤화할 수 있는 유연성을 제공하고자 합니다. 단백질이 중요한 이유는 무엇입니까? 단백질은 중요한 부분 회복이며 운동 후 섭취하면 근육을 재구성하는 데 도움이 됩니다. 모든 G ESSNTL 단백질 파우더는 고품질의 "완벽한" 단백질로 만들어져 신체가 자체적으로 만들 수 없는 필수 아미노산을 모두 함유하고 있습니다. 분리 유청 단백질의 차이점은 무엇입니까? 분리 유청은 사용 가능한 가장 순수한 유청 단백질 중 하나입니다. 몸이 자체적으로 만들 수 없는 필수 아미노산을 모두 함유한 고품질의 빠르게 흡수하는 단백질입니다. 분리 유청 단백질은 근육 단백질 합성을 촉진하는 핵심 아미노산인 분지 사슬 아미노산(BCAA)과 류신의 좋은 공급원입니다. 다른 유형의 유청 단백질에 비해 지방이 낮습니다. G ESSNTL 분리 유청 단백질 파우더는 설탕, 인공 향료 또는 감미료를 첨가하지 않았습니다.

Pure High-DH Hydrolyzed Whey Protein. DH is the Degree of Hydrolysis, which indicates the extent to which the protein has been broken down. Higher DH means more rapid and complete absorption. In order to be absorbed, protein must be hydrolyzed down to amino acids or to the smallest peptides, called di and tripeptides. Whole proteins, including whey isolates, concentrates, caseins, soy, and blends are large proteins and naturally contain little to no Micro Peptides, and no di and tripeptides. Proto Whey is 100% Micro Peptides, of which, up to 40% are di and tripeptides. Targeted Protein Delivery. The di and tripeptides in Proto Whey target the PEPT-1 transporter which transports over 8,400 different di and tripeptides. Whole protein digestion relies heavily on amino acid transporters which are far more specific and transport only a fraction of what PEPT-1 transporters do. The speed and efficiency of the PEPT-1 transport system allows for faster delivery of protein throughout the body and bypasses other systems that can limit the delivery of amino acids. Di and tripeptides carry metabolic information not present in amino acids. High-DH proteins delivery protein into the blood primarily as di and tripeptides whereas whole protein digestion often results in single amino acids. More Proto Whey Advantages. Requires less breakdown and digestive energy than whole proteins. Contains 10 grams of essential amino acids per serving. EAAs cannot be synthesized by the body and must be supplied by the diet.. Employs DEM (digestive energy matrix), a unique combination of SoftPsil micronized psyllium fiber and MCTs (medium chain triglycerides) to provide digestive energy and help maintain optimum intestinal health. High-DH reduces allergenicity. Low glycemic response. Mixes easily - no blender required. Industry-leading, rich and creamy taste profile.

description:

Product Profile

Dietary protein is the only nutrient group that yields an appreciable amount of amino acids upon digestion. Since amino acids are the building blocks needed to create functional and structural proteins in the body, from antibodies for immune function to collagen for skin and bones, it is essential to consume adequate amounts. But when the body lacks an adequate supply of nitrogen compounds like protein and amino acids, a state referred to as “negative nitrogen balance,” it is forced to break down muscle tissue to liberate reserves. The opposite situation, a surplus (i. e., positive nitrogen balance), is necessary for muscle growth. So in order to build or maintain musculature, extra dietary protein is needed.

Beyond Amino Acids

Whey not only contains a complete amino acid profile but also a host of other beneficial factors. These factors include alpha-lactalbumin, beta-lactoglobulin, lactoferrin, serum albumin, lysozyme, and immunoglobulins A, G, and M. In addition, whey protein provides more of the essential amino acids than other protein sources. Furthermore, about 25% of the amino acids in whey typically consist of branched chain amino acids (BCAAs). BCAAs are readily oxidized as an energy source during and after stress and exercise. Whey protein is a source of cysteine, a precursor to the vital intracellular antioxidant glutathione (GSH). GSH is depleted by oxidative stress that occurs during exercise, immune defense, and healing. Some researchers contend that whey protein plays a role in immune health by providing GSH precursors and increasing levels of GSH in tissue.

View larger

Distinguishing Features:

  • 100% Natural Whey Concentrate
  • Easily Dissolvable
  • No Artificial Sweeteners or Additives
  • Reduced Fat & Lactose Content
  • No Added Hormones - rBST Free
Whey Protein: Concentrate vs. Isolate

The debate about “the best type” of whey protein is a frequent topic of discussion on bodybuilding message boards. Typically, one form is advocated based solely upon the manufacturing method used to produce it. For instance, whey protein isolate (WPI) is commonly touted as being a “purer” form of whey because it typically goes through more processing steps. However, these processing steps can destroy and eliminate some of the components that provide additional benefits. Whey protein concentrate (WPC) generally undergoes gentle processing, leaving many of the other natural components intact. In addition, the majority of clinical studies investigating the effects of whey protein supplementation have been conducted using WPC. Ultimately, the type of whey protein chosen (WPC vs. WPI) may not be as critical as the quality of its sources and the other components added to the final product (such as sugar or artificial ingredients versus natural flavoring, etc). When evaluating the quality of a whey protein product, one should read the Nutrition Facts panel to check for the source of ingredients (e. g. non-GMO, rBST-free) and the presence/absence of additives like artificial flavors and sweeteners.

Benefits Of Jarrow Formulas Whey Protein

Jarrow Formulas Whey Protein is made with whey protein concentrate that is certified to be free of recombinant bovine growth hormone (rBST). It comes only from U.S. cows and is made in small batches in an environmentally conscious facility that supports local dairy farms. It uses the high quality rennet enzyme system, which concentrates protein and preserves glutamine while producing a superior end product. Elevated temperatures are avoided during the manufacturing process. High temperatures and spray-drying can lead to the degradation of glutamine, which is an important amino acid for the synthesis of muscle tissue and for immune function. Finally, the product is ultrafiltered to remove greater amounts of lactose and fat from the final product, and it is free of any artificial flavors, colors, or sweeteners.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

description:
About the Pro JYM Protein Powder: Supported Goals: Muscle - Growth - Strength. What It Is: The perfect blend of three of the most effective types of proteins for building muscle: whey, micellar casein, and egg protein. The three types of protein are absorbed in the body at varying rates of speed – whey extremely fast, casein very slowly, and egg at a “medium” pace. This is exactly how you want your protein to act both before and after workouts to ensure that the muscles get an immediate supply of amino acids (the building blocks of protein) as well as a steady trickle of them in the hours following. Research now suggests that when you add medium-digesting and slow-digesting proteins to fast-digesting whey, muscle protein synthesis remains elevated for longer than when using whey alone. And muscle protein retention is higher, as well. That means that more protein is being built in the muscle. That is what may help lead to long-term gains in muscle growth and strength. What Sets It Apart: Aside from being a protein blend in a crowded market of sometimes underperforming 100% whey protein powders, Pro JYM is also a non-proprietary blend. A proprietary blend is any supplement that doesn't list the precise amount of every single active ingredient it contains. This isn’t just prevalent with pre-workouts and fat-burners – a lot of protein powders on the market are proprietary blends because they don’t tell you the exact amounts of the proteins in the formula. Pro JYM, on the other hand, lists the exact amounts on the front of the container of all three types of proteins in their four distinct forms: whey protein isolate (7.5 grams), micellar casein (7 grams), egg albumen (2.5 grams) and milk protein isolate (7 grams – 5.5 grams casein, 1.5 grams whey).

Nitrogen spiking (aka “amino spiking” or “protein spiking”) is an unscrupulous technique where some supplement companies put in less protein than what’s listed on the label as a means of slashing costs and increasing their protein margins – at the user’s expense. Getting a “spiked” protein means paying for, say, 24 grams of protein but getting only 18 grams of actual whole proteins. With Pro JYM, you get all 24 grams, guaranteed. Pro JYM is not and never will be spiked with cheap fillers.

What Is Casein Protein Powder?

Casein protein powder is a protein derived from milk. Milk contains two types of protein: casein and whey. description: True Nutrition’s Whey Protein Isolate Microfiltration is derived from whey protein concentrate, but ultimately from sweet dairy whey. Whey Protein Isolates, including Whey Protein Isolate Microfiltration, Whey Protein Isolate Cold-Filtration, are protein powders that are the next steps to further process whey protein concentrate. The Microfiltration process is a procedure of separating the proteins through the use of filters. These filters allow the protein to be removed from the unwanted fat, lactose and the like. Microfiltration Isolate is virtually fat free and lactose (sugar) free. Whereas the harmful Ion-Exchange process uses electrical charge and chemicals to extract the protein, Microfiltration uses a more natural way of extracting protein through filters that do not have the same harmful effects in denaturing the bioactive ingredients. Microfiltered isolates are left with more calcium and give the user the highest level of undenatured protein available in a whey protein isolate. The extraction process leaves the final product almost all protein, around 90% protein. Whey Protein Isolate Microfiltration is a great whey protein for users who experience bloating and other problems associated with whey protein concentrate. As well, for users who want a higher protein percentage per serving, an Isolate is a great choice. Whey Protein Microfiltration possesses an extremely clean taste. description:
What Is Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate?

Whey is a substance produced during cheese production. It is the liquid content that remains after the milk has curdled and coagulated. Whey can be processed and isolated into three different types of protein: whey protein isolate, whey protein concentrate, and whey protein hydrolysate. This particular form of whey isolate is hydrolyzed, meaning that proteins are broken into small segments to promote rapid and easy digestion. Because of this, amino acid delivery into the bloodstream can be much faster than in typical whey protein.

Hydrolyzed Whey Protein Isolate Benefits

Hydrolyzed whey protein isolate powder is a rich source of protein that may support muscle growth and aid in the recovery of exhausted muscles after anaerobic exercise.* This protein powder is also a rich source of leucine and branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs), essential amino acids that are largely found in muscle tissues and used primarily in the production of proteins.
